verdict.rationale: Official docs and GitHub README explicitly state you can sign into your existing ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business, Edu, or Enterprise subscription plan to use Codex, with a documented 'Sign in with ChatGPT' flow as the recommended method (API key is only an alternative). Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of the sign-in flow itself (community evidence focuses on usage limits/quality, not the sign-in mechanism).
